items.question: Do I need any experience?
items.answer: None at all. Beginners sessions assume you have never done this before — we start on the floor, at ground level, and nothing is compulsory.

items.question: How much is a first class?
items.answer: First class is £15 for 60 minutes. There's no contract and no membership. If your first session isn't for you, we refund it — nobody has asked yet.

items.question: What should I bring?
items.answer: Just trainers. All kit is provided, every session is coach-led and capped at twelve, and it's free to cancel up to 12 hours before.

items.question: Where exactly do you train?
items.answer: Six sites across London — Vauxhall, Peckham Rye, Southbank, Stratford East, Hackney Marshes and Wembley Park. Every one is a ten-minute walk from a tube or overground station.

still_stuck.title: STILL STUCK?
still_stuck.body: Send the form above, or email us direct. A coach reads every message — usually the same working day.
